why: PHONE-DRILL-TP-CLOSE: a phone REDUCE (partial close) is served only to an app build that declares 'reduce' in its claim; otherwise it ends refused at claim with ONE ping, and the position is unchanged. Builds up to 1b.380 do not execute a reduce: their reduce branch clicks the armed Close position to measure the dialog, then dismisses it and reports failed. Once PR #25226 opens the sheet on the cards layout, a one-tap venue Close would turn a reduce into a FULL close reported as failed. A full close is unaffected. Capability negotiation, the same pattern as amend/cancel/close. Adds no execution gate.
